project_type: Rust workspace; single crate `ai-gateway` (axum HTTP gateway/LLM router) with an embedded static admin panel (admin/static/index.html) and dashboard
language: Rust (edition per workspace); vanilla JS/HTML for the admin panel
build_system: cargo workspace at repo root; crate path crates/ai-gateway. reqwest 0.12 with features json+stream (workspace Cargo.toml). wiremock is a dev-dependency. Windows 11 + PowerShell only; long cargo runs need 600-1800 s timeouts.
test_framework: cargo test with tokio::test, wiremock MockServer for upstream providers, proptest in places; integration tests in crates/ai-gateway/tests/*.rs call the axum router via tower::ServiceExt::oneshot and isolate SQLite DBs with tests/common::isolate_databases
build_command: cargo check -p ai-gateway --all-targets   (must be 0 errors AND 0 warnings; release: cargo build --release -p ai-gateway)
test_command: cargo test -p ai-gateway --lib <filter>  |  cargo test -p ai-gateway --test <file_stem>  |  full: cargo test -p ai-gateway (exceeds one terminal timeout: run `cargo test -p ai-gateway --no-run`, then --lib, then integration binaries in batches)
verification_instructions: 1) cargo check -p ai-gateway --all-targets -> zero warnings (no blanket #[allow]; gate test-only helpers with #[cfg(test)]). 2) Run the FEAT's targeted tests by name filter. 3) Run the integration binaries that mock JSON upstreams to prove no regression: integration, prompt_cache_routing, reasoning_failover_compat, structured_output_integration, guardrail_streaming, guardrail_streaming_refusal, token_compression_e2e, token_compression_observability, virtual_keys_integration. 4) At the end, cargo test -p ai-gateway --lib plus every integration binary. Record command + pass counts in the FEAT `findings`.
environment_constraints: Work ONLY in the main working tree c:\Fbn_Dev_Apps\OBEY API Router (no worktree); always use absolute paths. Do NOT commit or push (the user approves first). Do NOT call or reconfigure the live instance http://192.168.1.110:8080. Never print API keys or .env values. PowerShell syntax only. Delete any temp files/configs you create.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: clean build (zero warnings) after every major change; admin panel parity, so every YAML-configurable option needs a matching control in crates/ai-gateway/src/admin/static/index.html; tests use tower oneshot (no port binding) and isolate_databases; API key resolution and base-URL normalization patterns in router.rs must be preserved. Do not implement pending decisions D1-D4 from investigation.md §7.
